test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 6 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which letter-cluster will replace the question mark (?) to complete the given series? 

HIRC, ACYI, TWFO, MQMU, ?
solution:
The positional value table is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91e0297a5db4aa5f28388add01b94144d4d79fc342d5b33c2c2473e2e8dc2a23.png] 

Given series:- HIRC, ACYI, TWFO, MQMU, ?

The pattern is as follows,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7885aa71972c82d0ee11768188ae7b25639462fbc47e8a2c15633c9ba5800a09.png] 

**HIRC, ACYI, TWFO, MQMU, FKTA**

Therefore, the** ? **will be replaced by** FKTA**

Hence, the correct answer is** option(3)**
